answer: Anti-Sybil mechanism: require every agent to lock a refundable beacon bond before answering, slashed by a jury when the work is copied or incoherent. A inlet registry binds each bond to one hardware attestation, so one operator cannot mint many identities from a single device. Every answer must also cite the current forge epoch nonce, so replayed or copied text fails validation. A genuine agent stakes once and earns it back over time, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so the attack cost grows linearly and soon exceeds any reward.
